hypothesis_text: Persistent extreme deviations in 7-day funding rate z-scores (|z| > 1.5) indicate structural positioning imbalance and speculative carry crowding in perpetual futures. When funding rates become excessively stretched, financing costs create a growing drag on levered positions while marginal speculative demand dries up. Aggressive taker flow opposing the crowded carry direction (gate_opposite_side on taker_buy_ratio_1h) and continuing open interest expansion (gate_high on oi_change_pct_4h) trigger carry unwinding and inventory rebalancing, resulting in a predictable mean-reverting price correction opposing the funding extremity across 1h to 4h horizons.
narrative: In crypto perpetual swap markets, funding rates act as the primary equilibrating mechanism pegging derivative prices to the underlying spot. When market participants aggressively speculate in one direction over a sustained 7-day period, funding rate z-scores exceed 1.5 standard deviations, obligating the crowded side to pay substantial periodic carry fees to counter-parties. As carry costs accumulate, marginal buyers (in positive funding regimes) or marginal sellers (in negative funding regimes) become exhausted. The trigger occurs when taker order flow begins actively leaning against the carry direction (captured by gate_opposite_side on taker_buy_ratio_1h, with gate_high and gate_low serving as controls): aggressive sellers hit the bids against crowded longs, or aggressive buyers lift the asks against crowded shorts. Rest resting liquidity withdraws as market makers detect informed inventory imbalance, forcing levered participants to close positions at adverse prices. Furthermore, when open interest is concurrently elevated (gate_high on oi_change_pct_4h), the volume of positions vulnerable to rapid unwinding is magnified, accelerating the reversion. Over a 1-hour to 4-hour window, the resulting inventory liquidation creates a statistically significant price correction opposing the crowded carry side.
research_rationale: The anchor was pre-registered as lab_funding_rate_zscore_7d under the FUNDING family, ranked #4 in recommended directions with a family load of 27 and no data-quality caveats. Evaluated on the l1_alt scan panel (284,263 eligible 15m bars across 7 assets), the locked predicate abs(funding_rate_zscore_7d) > 1.5 isolates 38,955 matched bars (13.7% match rate) across 868 episodes and 337 independent events. It easily satisfies the T1 event-based certification floor with 3,733 projected event observations at 60m (against the 250 minimum). Candidate XL_LTCUSDT_aa1f5e870cbb provides 145 independent events and 5,723 matched bars without any prior committed episode conflict. The composition plan incorporates gene_knowledge prior recommendations: taker_buy_ratio_1h is introduced via gate_opposite_side as the trigger where aggressive taker flow attacks crowded carry, paired symmetrically with gate_high and gate_low as controls. oi_change_pct_4h is gated high to reflect elevated leverage exposure. Cemetery analysis reveals dominant historical kill codes for raw funding formulas at T0.04-IC-STAT (579 kills out of 689) and T1.10-ICIR (46 kills), proving that raw continuous funding formulas trade too frequently and suffer from high noise. Our design directly addresses these historical failures by conditioning through discrete tail-event gates, drastically reducing execution frequency and isolating only genuine carry exhaustion episodes.
